title: ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to expanding the Healthy Neighborhood Market Program in Council District 15.
text:
[Council File 22-0437-S1; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to expanding the Healthy Neighborhood Market Program in Council District 15.
Recommendation for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the Economic and Workforce Development Department report dated October 14, 2025, attached to the Council file.

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 9, 2026); Council action final

summary: Council is asked to receive and file an Economic and Workforce Development Department report on expanding the Healthy Neighborhood Market Program in Council District 15, with no new action.
